name: Montserrat

findings.controller: Southern Caribbean Fiber (Digicel Group), operator and maintainer
findings.local_actor: Government of Montserrat (owns beach manhole and cable landing station)
findings.financier: UK Government (Capital Investment Programme for Resilient Economic Growth, CIPREG)
findings.summary: Montserrat's first submarine fibre link since 1995, a 25 km cable via Antigua and Guadeloupe, went live in October 2020; Digicel subsidiary Southern Caribbean Fiber installed it and operates it under a 15-year contract, with UK CIPREG funding.
findings.analyst_inference: No cable or terminal-equipment manufacturer is named in any source; SCF (Digicel Group, Caribbean-headquartered, non-US/PRC) is documented as operating and maintaining the system, so it is treated as controller, pole third. Announced value converted from 'more than XCD 16m' (15-year contract) at the fixed XCD 2.70/USD peg, a floor not a total. A July 2023 subsea break story (not opened) suggests continued use, but current status not confirmed, so still_current null. Lightwave and MNI likely share a release origin.
